We create fun and educational videos for children learning English from the comfort of their own homes. Go on an adventure and explore Explore Planet English's range of fun, free and hands-on content! Watch fun and memorable lessons, play games, cook, learn how to create, learn about STEM, practise your dance move and sing along to original music on our journey around the wonderful world of learning. 

Start to enjoy learning today: https://www.exploreplanetenglish.com/
